sentences.3: Sukuna notices the situation after defeating Jogo and uses his immense speed to rescue Shigemo before he's crushed by Mahoraga.
sentences.4: By rescuing the curse user, Sukuna avoided ending the ritual, saving Megumi's life.
sentences.5: Sukuna confirms his hunch was right and recognizes the situation Megumi is in.
sentences.6: He still has plans for the young sorcerer, so Sukuna heals him with reverse cursed technique.
sentences.7: In order to save Megumi, Sukuna sets his sights on defeating Mahoraga and voiding the ritual altogether.(Chapter 117, Episode 41)
